result:
The disk filled up and the database took the api down with it: the `report-export` job wrote 40 files of 512 MB each (20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` between 03:05:00 and 03:12:48, pushing `/var/lib/stockroom` from 91% at 03:09:03 to 99% at 03:13:30.

The deciding line is `2026-03-09T03:14:00 ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`. The api then aborted its transaction and exited at 03:14:06 (`FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`).

It never came back: the proxy logged `upstream api refused connection` every 2 minutes from 03:16:00 through 05:28:00 (67 times), and the log ends at 05:29:57 with no restart.

The `cache: slow command` warnings run at a steady 100–150 ms from 02:00 onward, before and after the crash, so they are unrelated.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` and restart the api. To stop a repeat, the export needs to write to a different volume or be capped or cleaned up; the job isn't defined in this repo, so I couldn't check how it's configured.

The log is dated 2026-03-09, not last night, so confirm this is the right file for the outage you mean.
